high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the website "livescience.com." The page features an article about scientific research involving the imaging of heat within an exotic superfluid state of cold lithium-6 atoms using a new heat-mapping technique. The text explains that this phenomenon shows heat moving as a wave, bouncing like sound around its container. The article discusses the implications of understanding how second sound moves, which could help scientists predict heat flow inside ultradense neutron stars and high-temperature superconductors.
